purpose: Teach: 晒さ/信奉/軒並み/制圧/編纂/標榜/帰化/枯渇

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者情報が外部に晒される事のないよう、医療チームで徹底します
lines.en: Ren, we ensure patient information never leaves this hospital. The medical team takes that responsibility seriously.
lines.style: Steady, composed opening. Clear commitment without overstatement. Direct eye contact level. Shoulders settled. A doctor delivering a promise, not a threat.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、特定の療法を信奉する患者さんへの対応を医療チームで研修します
lines.en: We'll also train the team on how to work with patients who hold strong beliefs about specific treatments.
lines.style: Measured, professional. Slight warmth underneath — not dismissing patient beliefs, but acknowledging the complexity. Even pacing. Grounded.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 地域の診療所が軒並み閉鎖された事を、貴院、心配されてますね、先生
lines.en: I've noticed your hospital seems concerned about all the local clinics shutting down, Doctor.
lines.style: Thoughtful, carefully observant. Not accusatory — genuinely curious. Slight pause before 'shutting down,' like he's registering the weight of it. Respectful distance in the phrasing.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、感染症を制圧する取り組みを医療チームで続けます
lines.en: We'll continue working to bring infectious disease under control. That's part of our commitment to the community.
lines.style: Steady repeat of the foundational tone. Neither defensive nor defensive-sounding. Professional continuity. Slight emphasis on 'commitment' — not selling it, just stating it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医学史を編纂する作業を、貴院、なさってるそうですね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital is working on compiling medical history? That's an interesting project, Doctor.
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, respectful. Voice lifts slightly on 'interesting' — not flattery, just recognition. Leans in slightly with the question. Third-hour-conversation energy.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、地域医療を標榜する病院として責任を持ちます
lines.en: As a hospital dedicated to community medicine, we have a responsibility to document this. That's part of what we do.
lines.style: Calm, grounded conviction. 'Responsibility' lands with quiet weight. No apology, no overreach — just stating what matters. Slow enough to be heard.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 帰化された外国人医師との連携を、貴院、強化されてますね、先生
lines.en: I've also heard you're strengthening your partnerships with naturalized foreign physicians. That's smart.
lines.style: Observant, impressed. Light recognition in 'smart.' Ren is noticing something good here, respectfully. Slightly warmer than previous observations. Still thoughtful pacing.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療資源の枯渇に備えた計画を医療チームで進めます
lines.en: We're planning ahead for resource constraints. The medical team is working on that now, and it matters.
lines.style: Quiet firmness closing a conversation. No trailing energy — land on 'matters' with gentle finality. Tired shoulders, steady voice. The doctor who knows what's coming and is preparing anyway.
